name: Procurement document lifecycle and three-way matching verification
description: User opens the procurement workspace, inspects Purchase Orders, GRNs, Supplier Invoices, and checks 3-Way Match variance resolution.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Procurement section from the sidebar navigation menu
Verify the procurement tab bar is visible containing Purchase Orders, Goods Receipts, Supplier Invoices, and Payments tabs
Click on the Supplier Invoices tab and select an invoice with a 3-Way Match badge
Verify the 3-Way Match resolution modal opens showing unit price, quantity tolerance variance breakdown, and resolution options
